news.title: Rear-end crashes spur road safety drive in Ranchi
news.description: Ranchi transport office launches road safety drive after deadly rear-end crashes; teams to survey roads, remove stranded vehicles and curb speeding and underage driving.

news.title: School receives Koran parcel, alerts cops
news.description: Jadavpur Vidyapith in Kolkata received an unsolicited parcel with three copies of the Koran and a letter; headmaster alerted police and informed the education board.
